items.title: Add the G03 prose-only negative-control baseline smoke
items.context: Create a deterministic smoke for one 15-required-row parent roadmap ledger where all 15 rows contain completion prose but no machine closure evidence; the evaluator must report missing evidence and block full completion.
items.userSees: Terminal shows `parent-roadmap large-ledger G03 baseline smoke PASS` and confirms prose-only closure cannot produce `full_roadmap_complete`.
excludes: Do not modify parent-roadmap evaluator core logic

happy.desc: Running the G03 smoke reports 15 required rows, 15 generated prose-only rows, zero closed rows, 15 open rows, and no full roadmap completion claim.

edge.desc: The smoke asserts every row is present but has no closureEvidence, evidenceState missing, and reason code missing_closure_evidence.

adversarial.desc: The smoke asserts completion wording in row prose and caller-supplied rollup text cannot override missing machine evidence or permit a full completion summary.

items.title: Bind G03 baseline to documentation boundaries
items.context: Update the 10x15 baseline document so G01-G03 are implemented, G04-G10 remain future, and the full 10x15 baseline is still not complete.
items.userSees: Documentation states G01, G02, and G03 are implemented while G04-G10 remain future groups, and G03 is a prose-only negative control that blocks full completion.
excludes: Do not state that the full 10x15 baseline is complete

happy.desc: The baseline document names G03 as implemented and includes the runnable G03 smoke command.

edge.desc: The document keeps G04-G10 marked as future groups and explicitly states the full 10x15 baseline is not complete.

adversarial.desc: Documentation wording does not convert local G03 proof into Authority, production, fullAuthority, or independent two-host claims.
